title: RECAP: Training Long-horizon LLM Agents with Context Compaction
abstract: arXiv:2611.31258v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Context compaction enables large language model agents to tackle long-horizon tasks within limited context budgets by replacing interaction histories with compressed summaries. However, learning effective compaction jointly with the agent policy remains challenging, as summaries affect task success over many subsequent interactions. We introduce RECAP, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework based on the principle that a summary should preserve the behavior induced by the original interaction history. We formalize this principle with a behavior distortion objective that measures the divergence between the agent's subsequent behavior under compressed and original contexts. We show that the gradient of the distortion objective decomposes into two complementary learning signals: distortion-based reward for summary generation and self-distillation for subsequent actions. translated_title: RECAP：通过上下文压缩训练长时程LLM智能体
translated_abstract: 上下文压缩使大型语言模型智能体能够通过用压缩摘要替换交互历史，在有限的上下文预算内完成长时程任务。然而，将有效压缩与智能体策略进行联合学习仍然具有挑战性，因为摘要的质量会在后续多次交互中影响任务的成功与否。我们提出了RECAP，这是一个基于“摘要应当保留原始交互历史所诱导的行为”这一原则的强化学习（RL）框架。我们通过一个行为失真目标来形式化这一原则，该目标衡量智能体在压缩上下文与原始上下文下后续行为之间的差异。我们证明该失真目标的梯度可以分解为两个互补的学习信号：用于摘要生成的基于失真的奖励，以及用于后续动作的自蒸馏。在Qwen3.5-4B上的实验表明，RECAP持续优于……（原文此处截断）
tldr: RECAP提出一种强化学习框架，通过行为失真目标将摘要生成与智能体策略联合训练，使压缩摘要能够保留原始交互历史所诱导的行为，从而提升智能体在长时程任务中的表现。
en_tdlr: RECAP is an RL framework that jointly trains summarization and agent policy through a behavior distortion objective, ensuring compressed summaries preserve the behavior induced by original interaction histories to improve long-horizon task performance.
